cli.description: zapwebp — SVG → WebP, safe, reversible, and scoped.
cmd.init: Set up config, ignore rules, and .gitignore
cmd.audit: Dry-run + safety audit report or command linter
cmd.check: CI mode: exit 1 if any conversion is needed
cmd.explain: Explain why a file will or won't convert
cmd.ignored: Explain why files are skipped by ignore rules
cmd.undo: Revert the last run (or a specific transaction)
cmd.gc: Prune old journal logs and backups
cmd.inspect: Analyze image container and metadata chunks
flag.smart: Deterministic pixel analysis to recommend/apply best format
flag.since: Filter report by timeframe (e.g. "30 days ago", "7d")
flag.fit: Fitting mode: contain, cover, fill, inside, outside
flag.clean: Strip AI provenance and metadata (default: true)
flag.verify: Verify output SHA-256 matches expected hash before writing
flag.verify_clean: Enforce 0 metadata chunks and Clean Certificate
flag.assert_alpha: Strictly fail if transparent input loses alpha
flag.lock_target: Enforce many-to-one conversion to specified format
flag.strict: Strictly fail on unconvertible inputs (default when locked)
flag.same_format: Action when input matches target: passthrough (default), reencode, reject
flag.size_mode: Size contract enforcement: compress (default), strict, flexible
flag.flexible: Alias for --size-mode flexible (warn only, never reject or degrade)
flag.min_input: Reject inputs smaller than minimum byte limit (e.g. 500B, 10KB)
flag.max_input: Reject inputs larger than maximum byte limit (e.g. 15MB)
flag.min_output: Validate output meets minimum byte size
flag.max_output: Compress or validate output under maximum byte size
flag.target: Target maximum output size with adaptive compression (e.g. 500kb, 1mb)
flag.no_downscale: Disallow downscaling to meet target size
flag.no_lock: Do not write or verify cryptographic conversion lock
flag.lock_status: Inspect and verify conversion lock metadata for a file
flag.override_lock: Explicit opt-in to bypass configured target lock
flag.zip: Bundle outputs into a single ZIP archive
flag.changed: Only convert files modified vs HEAD (git)
flag.staged: Only convert files in git staging area
flag.include_all: Bypass all ignore layers including built-ins
flag.allow_unsafe: Permit SVGs with minor safety warnings
flag.force_undo: Force undo even if outputs were modified
flag.dry_run: Plan conversion without writing files or journal
flag.unlimited: No limit on files, session, or request byte size
flag.max_bytes: Max total input bytes across request (e.g. 100MB)
flag.lang: Set interface and message language (e.g. en, tl)
cli.safety_telemetry: Zero telemetry. Zero network calls. Files never leave your machine.
cli.safety_reversible: Reversible: every run creates an undoable journal in .zapwebp/journal/.
cli.safety_toctou: TOCTOU safe: files are re-verified immediately before writing.
cli.safety_atomic: Atomic writes: tmp -> rename ensures no half-written files.
